implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/pages/ApprovalsPage.tsx: Pending approval queue. Uses useApprovals(). Card list sorted by wait time (longest first = most urgent at top). Each card (Card component): readable summary of what agent wants to do (job type + capabilities), policy rule that triggered the approval requirement, workflow context (if applicable, with link), wait time displayed prominently. Urgency badges: computed from wait time — <5min default/muted, >5min warning badge, >15min danger badge with pulse animation. Real-time updates via WebSocket (auto-refetch). Approval count reflected in nav: useApprovals data length updates the nav badge in AppShell. Empty state: 'No pending approvals — all clear' with success icon.

implementationPlan.note: Fixed 2 tsc errors (unknown not assignable to ReactNode in JSX short-circuit). Used typeof guards instead of truthiness checks for Record<string, unknown> values. tsc clean.
